_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); beverage and convenient-food signals

pit_profile.why: PepsiCo: 'We are a leading global food and beverage company with a complementary portfolio of enjoyable brands, including Frito-Lay, Gatorade, Pepsi-Cola, Quaker and Tropicana'; 'Our beverage, food and snack products are in highly competitive industries and markets', and 'However, The Coca-Cola Company has significant carbonated soft drink (CSD) share advantage in many markets outside the United States' (its own FY2014 10-K): a competition and consumer-taste risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: PepsiCo: 'We are a leading global food and beverage company with a complementary portfolio of enjoyable brands, including Frito-Lay, Gatorade, Pepsi-Cola, Quaker and Tropicana'; 'Our beverage, food and snack products are in highly competitive industries and markets', and 'However, The Coca-Cola Company has significant carbonated soft drink (CSD) share advantage in many markets outside the United States' (its own FY2014 10-K): a competition and consumer-taste risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 11.42x; +42% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.60; conservative 2yr -9%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -5.0%/yr (worst year FY05-FY14, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +5.2%/yr (Q2 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +5.4%/yr (FY05-FY14 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +12.7%/yr (best 2-yr run FY05-FY14); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: PEP (retrospective, 2015-07-17) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 11.42x (38.0% downside to Bear $60 / +3.3% upside to Bull $100) | Adj composite 2.17 vs market 3.77: gap -1.60 [OVERVALUED] | +42% above the EPP floor $68 (16x FY15E $4.27) | Conservative 2-yr case: -9.4% total (-4.7%/yr) | At 22.7x FY15E the 15% hurdle price $128 sits above the BULL case; servings not reported for Q2 2015, forward revenues +4% (Q2 2015 net revenue ex-currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
